Frequently Asked Questions

Agile is a project management methodology that emphasizes flexibility, collaboration, and iterative development. It focuses on delivering small, functional pieces of a project frequently and adjusting based on feedback.

Scrum is a framework used in Agile that helps teams work together. It encourages teamwork, accountability, and iterative progress toward a well-defined goal. Scrum includes defined roles (Scrum Master, Product Owner, Development Team), events (Sprints, Daily Scrum), and artifacts (Product Backlog, Sprint Backlog).

Agile and Scrum training is beneficial for anyone involved in project management, product development, or business processes. Typical attendees include product managers, project managers, software developers, business analysts, and team leaders who want to improve their Agile knowledge and practice.

In Scrum training, you will learn the Scrum framework, including its principles, roles, and ceremonies. You will also understand how to effectively work within Agile teams, how to facilitate Scrum events, and how to improve product delivery through iterative development.

No prior experience is required to take Scrum training. The training is suitable for both beginners looking to understand Agile and Scrum and experienced professionals seeking to deepen their knowledge.
